artifacts.content:
# Impact Assessment: Merchant Refund Console

## Legend
| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Source 1 | PRD: `L0-requirements-prd-composer`|
| Status (*Draft / In-Review / Approved*) | Draft |
| Approved by (Human Name) | *Human Name* |
| Date of Approval | *Date* |
| Human Approval Comments | *Comments* |

> KB: kb-L1-architecture-principles (Confluence page_id 524091393) — mode: cross-check mode

## Executive Summary & Overview
Merchant Refund Console lets merchants self-serve refunds, removing the manual support-ticket path.

One new component is added and three existing systems are extended. The Payments Ledger carries the highest blast radius because every refund writes to it; Settlement Batch must map the new REFUND posting type.
- **Overall impact level:** Medium — 1 of 4 FR rows High (Payments Ledger); others Low/Medium
- **Existing systems:** 3 impacted, 0 explicitly excluded by architecture decision; duplicate-build risk: none found
- **External dependencies:** 1 total, 0 newly surfaced by this assessment
- **Flags:** None

## Non-Functional & Regulatory Impact
Ledger writes must stay inside the existing 500 ms p99 posting SLA (CON-001). Refund records follow the existing 7-year financial retention.

## Existing-System Impact
**Capability check (service catalog, service grain):** Closest: SVC-001 Payments Service (posts charges and refunds via API but has no merchant UI — reused, not duplicated); SVC-002 Notification Service (reused for FR-003).

**Technical impact check (CMDB, configuration-item grain):**

| Existing System (CI) | impacted? | How / Why Not | Component(s) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Payments Ledger (CI-1001) | Yes | New REFUND posting type | FR-002 |
| Mailer (CI-1002) | Yes | New confirmation template | FR-003 |
| Settlement Batch (CI-1003) | Yes | Must register new REFUND posting type in settlement mapping (KB AP-FIN-04; CMDB REL-1 Payments Ledger feeds Settlement Batch) | FR-002 |

## Components Identified
| Requirement | Component (new/existing) | Blast Radius | Rationale |
|---|---|---|---|
| FR-001 | Refund Console UI (new) | Low | New merchant screen; isolated. |
| FR-002 | Payments Ledger (existing) | High | Shared financial system of record gains a new write path. |
| FR-003 | Mailer (existing) | Low | Template only. |
| FR-002 | Settlement Batch (existing) | Medium | Downstream of Payments Ledger (REL-1); new REFUND posting type must be mapped per AP-FIN-04. |

## Data Model & Schema Impact
New RefundRequest entity; Payments Ledger gains REFUND posting type.

## Integration Landscape & External Dependencies
- **Upstream (enterprise platform):** Merchant SSO — Merchant login gate for the console.

## Assumptions & Out of Scope
Chargebacks out of scope.

## Dependency Graph
```mermaid
%%{ init: { 'flowchart': { 'nodeSpacing': 80, 'rankSpacing': 80 } } }%%
flowchart TD
    refund-console-ui["Refund Console UI"]
    payments-ledger["Payments Ledger"]
    mailer["Mailer"]
    settlement-batch["Settlement Batch"]
    merchant-sso(["Merchant SSO"])
    merchant-sso -->|blocks| refund-console-ui
    payments-ledger -->|depends on| refund-console-ui
    refund-console-ui -.->|integrates with| mailer
    payments-ledger -.->|integrates with| settlement-batch
    classDef newNode fill:#4a7fc1,stroke:#2d5a8e,color:#fff
    classDef existingNode fill:#e8a838,stroke:#b07820,color:#fff
    classDef unaffectedNode fill:#8c8c8c,stroke:#5a5a5a,color:#fff
    class refund-console-ui newNode
    class payments-ledger,mailer,settlement-batch existingNode
    %% CRITICAL PATH: payments-ledger -> refund-console-ui (length 1)
    %% CRITICAL PATH: merchant-sso -> refund-console-ui (length 1)
```
